DEATHKNIGHT_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Deathknight when:

  • Their Pillar of Frost is active, amplifying their strength during this critical damage window.
  • They activate Empower Rune Weapon, ensuring maximum resource generation and burst potential.
  • Both major cooldowns are active simultaneously for peak synergy with haste effects.
DEATHKNIGHT_UNHOLY:
Use Power Infusion on the Unholy Deathknight when:

  • They’re in a single-target plan or adds will persist, and:
  • Gargoyle is active with ≤22 seconds remaining OR their spec prioritizes:
  • Army of the Dead pets (Abomination with <18 seconds remaining, or Army Ghouls with ≤18 seconds) are active OR
  • Dark Transformation is active (without Gargoyle or Army of the Dead talents) OR
  • They can’t summon Gargoyle within 10 seconds of Power Infusion’s duration OR
  • Fighting ≥3 enemies with Dark Transformation active or Death and Decay ticking.
DEMONHUNTER_HAVOC:
Use Power Infusion on the Havoc Demonhunter when:

  • The Demonhunter is in Metamorphosis form to synergize with their primary damage-boosting cooldown.
  • The encounter will end within 20 seconds to capitalize on the final burst window.
DRUID_BALANCE:
Use Power Infusion on the Balance Druid when:

  • Their cooldown alignment is ready (variable.cd_condition) and they do not have TWW Season 3 Keeper of the Grove 4-piece tier set active.
  • They have TWW Season 3 Keeper of the Grove 4-piece tier set and their Celestial Alignment timing condition (variable.kotg_ca_condition) is met.
DRUID_FERAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Feral Druid when:

  • The Feral Druid's Incarnation: Avatar of Ashamane is currently active (if they do not use the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent).
  • The Feral Druid has the Berserk cooldown active (if they have the Berserk: Heart of the Lion talent).
EVOKER_DEVASTATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Devastation Evoker when:

  • They have Dragonrage active and either of these is true: Shattering Star is on cooldown, the target is affected by Shattering Star's debuff, or there are 2+ active enemies.
  • The encounter will end within 35 seconds to maximize cooldown utilization before combat finishes.
HUNTER_MARKSMANSHIP:
Use Power Infusion on the Marksmanship Hunter when:

  • The hunter's Trueshot buff will last longer than 12 seconds remaining, allowing full synergy with their major damage window.
  • The encounter will end in less than 13 seconds, ensuring the cooldown isn’t wasted before the fight concludes.
HUNTER_SURVIVAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Survival Hunter when:

  • Coordinated Assault is active with over 7 seconds remaining and they do not already have Power Infusion.
  • The Hunter does NOT have Coordinated Assault talented and Spearhead is available (off cooldown).
  • The Hunter is not using either Coordinated Assault or Spearhead talents.
MAGE_ARCANE:
Use Power Infusion on the Arcane Mage when:

  • They have just cast Arcane Surge (immediately after their previous global cooldown).
MAGE_FIRE:
Use Power Infusion on the Fire Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not already active, and either:
  • The Fire Mage has Combustion active with more than 6 seconds remaining or
  • The encounter will end in less than 25 seconds
MAGE_FROST:
Use Power Infusion on the Frost Mage when:

  • Power Infusion is not already active on them.
MONK_WINDWALKER:
Use Power Infusion on the Windwalker Monk when:

  • Xuen the White Tiger is active
  • Either Bloodlust is not active
  • Bloodlust is active and Strike of the Windlord is still on cooldown
PRIEST_SHADOW:
Use Power Infusion on the Shadow Priest when:

  • Voidform is active, Dark Ascension is active, or they have the The War Within 2-piece tier set bonus, and Power Infusion isn't already active.
ROGUE_ASSASSINATION:
Use Power Infusion on the Assassination Rogue when:

  • Their Deathmark bleed effect is currently active on a target, as this amplifies the burst damage window during their strongest offensive cooldown.
ROGUE_SUBTLETY:
Use Power Infusion on the Subtlety Rogue when:

  • Their Shadow Dance buff is active, ensuring alignment with their primary burst window for maximum damage amplification.
SHAMAN_ELEMENTAL:
Use Power Infusion on the Elemental Shaman when:

  • They have Ascendance active to amplify their burst damage window.
  • Ascendance is unavailable and its cooldown has more than 30 seconds remaining, to prevent holding Power Infusion excessively.
SHAMAN_ENHANCEMENT:
Use Power Infusion on the Enhancement Shaman when:

  • They have Deeply Rooted Elements talented and Ascendance has over 7.5 seconds remaining.
  • They do not have Deeply Rooted Elements talented and Ascendance, Feral Spirit, or Doom Winds are active.
  • The boss will die within 20 seconds of Power Infusion’s cooldown aligning with a 2-minute window.
  • All their major damage cooldowns are available and will remain off cooldown for at least 2 minutes.
  • They lack talents for Ascendance, Feral Spirit, and Doom Winds entirely (fallback scenario).
WARLOCK_AFFLICTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Affliction Warlock when:

  • Their Shadow Embrace debuff is fully applied to the target (3 stacks) OR
  • They activate burst major cooldowns (e.g., Summon Darkglare and Dark Soul: Misery) for maximum damage synergy
WARLOCK_DEMONOLOGY:
Use Power Infusion on the Demonology Warlock when:

  • They summon Demonic Tyrant while their Wild Imps are active and their imps’ remaining duration is shorter than 6 seconds plus your cast and GCD time, ensuring coverage during their extended burst window.
WARLOCK_DESTRUCTION:
Use Power Infusion on the Destruction Warlock when:

  • Their Summon Infernal is currently active for maximum burst damage synergy.
  • They haven’t selected the Summon Infernal talent, allowing flexible use outside of Infernal windows.
  • The fight will end before their next Summon Infernal cooldown plus 15 seconds, ensuring the buff isn’t wasted.
  • The remaining fight time is shorter than their next Summon Infernal cooldown plus 10 seconds and Power Infusion’s duration, but there’s still enough time for the full buff duration.
WARRIOR_ARMS:
Use Power Infusion on the Arms Warrior when:

  • the target is affected by Colossus Smash and the encounter will last at least 135 seconds longer
  • the target is in Execute phase (below 20% health) and they have Avatar active
  • the encounter will end in 25 seconds or less
WARRIOR_FURY:
Use Power Infusion on the Fury Warrior when:

  • The Fury Warrior has Avatar active with over 15 seconds remaining and the encounter will last longer than 135 seconds.
  • The Fury Warrior is in Execute Phase (target below 20% health) and Avatar is active.
  • The encounter will end in 25 seconds or less, regardless of other cooldowns.
